retrievalProfile.description: A radial collage featuring multiple portraits arranged within the spokes of a bicycle wheel, surrounded by vibrant psychedelic floral patterns.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central bicycle wheel acts as a frame for four human portraits oriented toward the center, set against a bright yellow background populated with stylized, swirling floral motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Portraits are radially symmetrical within the wheel spokes
Circular wheel frame contrasts with the square outer format
Vibrant yellow background provides high contrast for red and blue elements
Floral patterns create a secondary frame around the central wheel
coreInvariants: Bicycle wheel as a structural framing device

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four portraits occupy the quadrants of a large central bicycle wheel, scaled to fill the interior diameter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central hub of the bicycle wheel, often containing a small circular logo or text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the rim of the wheel, then moving inward along the spokes to the portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright yellow space between the wheel and the edges, filled with decorative floral icons.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and blue for floral patterns and text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and magenta for small decorative details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast between the yellow and dark rim.

letterConstructionRules: Text follows the curvature of the wheel rim
Heavy weight with high contrast outlines
Uniform stroke width for secondary metadata
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to fit a circular path
Hub text is condensed and stylized to fit a small circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif for titles paired with smaller, lighter sans-serif for track listings and credits.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and impact of the main title
Geometric qualities suit the circular composition

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright yellow square background with scattered 1960s style psychedelic flowers. Place a large bicycle wheel in the center with four portraits of men arranged radially inside the spokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, outlined sans-serif text following the top curve of the wheel rim. Add smaller text following the bottom curve of the rim and in the central hub.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a circular path?
Are the portraits oriented toward the center?
Is the background a vibrant yellow?
Are the floral patterns stylized and swirling?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the portraits
Ensure the bicycle wheel is perfectly centered
Verify that the floral patterns feel hand-drawn and psychedelic
Confirm the color palette is limited to high-saturation primaries
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Portrait Frame + Psychedelic Floral Background + Circular Path Typography
